entries.title: Two-factor sign-in
entries.description: You can turn on two-factor sign-in in Security settings, so logging in with your password also asks for a code from an authenticator app. Recovery codes let you get back in if you lose your phone.

entries.title: Discover trending anime, manga, and games
entries.description: Browse what’s trending, new this season, top rated, and coming soon right from Home and the landing page, and add titles to your library straight from the list.

entries.title: Leave a community
entries.description: You can leave a community from its header or the community menu in the sidebar. If it’s private, you’ll need a new invite to join again.

entries.title: A fresh landing page
entries.description: The landing page now opens with a slideshow of featured anime and shows live stats about the Orbis community.

entries.title: Clearer note when you can’t change images yet
entries.description: If you haven’t confirmed your email, the image menu now tells you to confirm it first and links you to your account settings, instead of letting an upload fail.
